hook.text: Tesla doesn't advertise. Zero dollars on traditional ads. Yet it's the world's most valuable car company.

buildup.text: Instead, Tesla built a referral program. Owners who refer buyers get perks like free Supercharging miles.

discovery.text: Tesla owners are passionate evangelists. The car itself is a conversation starter that sells to onlookers.

twist.text: Elon Musk's Twitter presence acts as free global advertising. One tweet reaches millions. No agency needed.

climax.text: By turning customers into advocates, Tesla saves billions on ads and uses that money for R&D instead.

punchline.text: Build a product people brag about owning.

quiz.question: How much does Tesla spend on traditional advertising?
